lessons.title: Tense Changes in Reported Speech
lessons.content: Reported speech is when we tell someone what another person said. When converting direct speech to reported speech, tenses shift back.

details.explanation: Direct Speech ရဲ့ Simple Present Tense ကို Reported Speech မှာ Simple Past Tense ပြောင်းပါတယ်။
details.example: She said, "I work at home." → She said that she worked at home. / He said, "I like this song." → He said that he liked that song.
details.burmese: Direct Speech ရဲ့ Simple Present Tense ကို Reported Speech မှာ Simple Past Tense ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

details.explanation: Direct Speech ရဲ့ Simple Past Tense ကို Reported Speech မှာ Past Perfect Tense ပြောင်းပါတယ်။
details.example: John said to mother, "You made my day..." → John told mother that she had made his day... / Sue said, "I was very happy." → She said that she had been very happy.
details.burmese: Direct Speech ရဲ့ Simple Past Tense ကို Reported Speech မှာ Past Perfect Tense ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

details.explanation: Modal Verbs တွေလည်း ပြောင်းပါတယ်။ will→would, can→could, may→might, must/have to→had to
details.example: "I will work." → She said she would work. / "I can work." → She said she could work.
details.burmese: Modal Verbs တွေလည်း ပြောင်းပါတယ်။ will→would, can→could, may→might, must/have to→had to

details.explanation: Present Continuous ကို Past Continuous ပြောင်းပါတယ်။
details.example: "I am working." → She said that she was working.
details.burmese: Present Continuous ကို Past Continuous ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

details.explanation: Present Perfect ကို Past Perfect ပြောင်းပါတယ်။
details.example: "She has finished her dance practice." → Adele said that she had finished her dance practice.
details.burmese: Present Perfect ကို Past Perfect ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

details.explanation: Past Perfect ကတော့ မပြောင်းပါဘူး။
details.example: "I had worked." → She said she had worked.
details.burmese: Past Perfect ကတော့ မပြောင်းပါဘူး။

lessons.title: Pronoun and Place/Time Changes
lessons.content: In reported speech, pronouns and place and time words also change.

details.explanation: Pronoun တွေ ပြောင်းပါတယ်။ I→he/she, We→they, my→his/her, your→my, our→their
details.example: I → he/she, We → they, my → his/her, your → my, our → their, me → him/her, us → them
details.burmese: Pronoun တွေ ပြောင်းပါတယ်။ I→he/she, We→they, my→his/her, your→my, our→their

details.explanation: Place နဲ့ Time words တွေ ပြောင်းပါတယ်။ this→that, here→there, today→that day, yesterday→the day before, tomorrow→the next day
details.example: this/these → that/those, here → there, today → that day, yesterday → the day before, tomorrow → the next/following day, last night → the night before, next → the following, last → the previous, ago → before
details.burmese: Place နဲ့ Time words တွေ ပြောင်းပါတယ်။ this→that, here→there, today→that day, yesterday→the day before, tomorrow→the next day
